result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and wide, tree-lined sidewalks that provide a comfortable walking environment. However, the crossing distance across multiple lanes lacks a central refuge island, and parked vehicles near the intersection may partially obstruct sight lines.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a central refuge island.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the right side may block the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide, well-maintained sidewalks and a high-visibility zebra crosswalk. The presence of a dedicated bike lane and mature street trees enhances the walking experience, though active traffic control at the crossing is not visible.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks visible stop signs or traffic signals to regulate vehicle flow and ensure pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install RRFBs to increase driver yielding rates at the uncontrolled crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking or bike lane area to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: A wide multi-lane urban intersection featuring high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and a green-painted bike lane. Despite the presence of basic infrastructure, the long unprotected crossing distance and car-oriented scale create significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island.

hazards.name: High-Speed Geometry
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a large, well-maintained pedestrian refuge island with mature trees and wide paved areas. While marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals are present, the overall crossing distance across multiple traffic lanes remains a significant factor for pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic on the main boulevard, increasing their exposure time to moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: The wide roadway crossing visible in the background and to the right.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.
